changes: Added a package-level prompt registry, registry-aware Codex verification, thin/full managed asset mode plumbing, opt-in init --asset-mode support, smoke tests, and README/decision docs for full versus thin prompt assets.
usage: Use default lattice init / koala init for legacy full prompt copies, or run lattice init --profile=codex --asset-mode=thin to write registry-backed Codex manifest assets without creating .Codex/agents prompt copies.
expectedOutcome: Users can opt into thin Codex prompt assets while existing full-mode repositories keep their .Codex/.claude prompt mirror behavior and hard verification semantics.
actualTranscript: Build, prompt-registry smoke, codex-registry-mode smoke, thin-init-assets smoke, validate, and verify_codex all passed. validate reported 15/15 verification intents covered; verify_codex reported Codex adapter checks passed 6/7 with only the expected global fallback warning.
outcomeDiff: No functional gap observed. The only transcript difference is the expected non-blocking global fallback warning because global koala points at the main checkout, not this story worktree.
limitations: Thin mode is explicit opt-in; existing full-mode projects are not silently migrated or cleaned. Current native host discovery still uses materialized Claude assets where that profile requires them.
pitfalls: During review, registry manifest validation initially checked only identity and registry hash; it now also hard-fails static registry manifest drift, and the smoke covers that case.
